auth.description: Webflow API token (a Site API token or an OAuth2 access token), sent as a bearer token, scoped to read sites, collections and items, and to publish
auth.name: webflow.token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: Generate a Site API token from your site's Settings -> Apps & Integrations -> API access, or register an OAuth app at developers.webflow.com for a token scoped across sites. A Site API token only ever sees the one site it was generated for; supply a per-site token for a single-site connection or an OAuth token for one that must span several
config.label: Webflow API token
config.name: token

description: Webflow sites and CMS: discover sites, read a collection's own field schema, read collection items of any tenant-defined shape, and publish a site live

operations.description: List the sites this token can see, with each site's id, display name, hosted subdomain and last-published time. The `id` returned here is what every other operation in this connector needs as `site_id`

id.description: The site's id — pass this as `site_id` to every other operation

lastPublished.description: Absent or null when the site has never been published

operations.description: List the CMS collections defined on a site, with each collection's id, display name and slug. Does not include a collection's fields — call webflow-collection-get for that. Returns Webflow's first page only; this connector declares no offset or limit parameter

params.description: The site's id, as returned by webflow-site-list
params.name: site_id

id.description: The collection's id — pass this as `collection_id` to every other collection operation

operations.description: Get a collection's own schema: its display name, slug, and the full list of fields the site owner defined for it — each field's id, slug, display name, type, and whether it is required. This is the honest way to learn what an item's fieldData will contain, since that shape is tenant-defined and unknowable at compile time; this connector cannot type fieldData any more precisely than this lets a caller discover it

params.description: The collection's id, as returned by webflow-collection-list
params.name: collection_id

fields.description: Every field this collection's items carry, tenant-defined — this is what makes an item's fieldData unknowable until this is fetched

slug.description: The key this field occupies inside an item's fieldData

type.description: Webflow's field type, e.g. PlainText, RichText, Number, Bool, Date, Image, Link, Reference, MultiReference, Option, Color — not enumerated further as a closed set, since Webflow may add types this file does not yet know about

operations.description: List the items in a collection, in Webflow's default order. Each item's fieldData is a flat object keyed by that collection's own field slugs — call webflow-collection-get to discover them; this connector cannot type fieldData beyond that, because it is defined per-tenant, per-collection. Returns Webflow's first page only; this connector declares no offset or limit parameter

params.description: The collection's id, as returned by webflow-collection-list
params.name: collection_id

fieldData.description: This item's custom fields, keyed by the collection's own field slugs. Genuinely unknowable at compile time — call webflow-collection-get to discover the keys and their types before reading this

id.description: The item's id — pass this as `item_id` to webflow-collection-item-get

lastPublished.description: Absent or null when this item has never been published

pagination.description: Offset/limit paging metadata; unusable here — this connector returns Webflow's first page only and declares no offset or limit parameter

operations.description: Get one item from a collection. Its fieldData is a flat object keyed by that collection's own field slugs — call webflow-collection-get to discover them; this connector cannot type fieldData beyond that, because it is defined per-tenant, per-collection

params.description: The collection's id, as returned by webflow-collection-list
params.name: collection_id

params.description: The item's id, as returned by webflow-collection-item-list
params.name: item_id

fieldData.description: This item's custom fields, keyed by the collection's own field slugs. Genuinely unknowable at compile time — call webflow-collection-get to discover the keys and their types before reading this

lastPublished.description: Absent or null when this item has never been published

operations.description: Publish a site's currently staged changes to its live, public domains — every connected custom domain and the Webflow-hosted subdomain. This has immediate public effect: whatever is staged goes live for every visitor as soon as this call returns, with no separate confirmation step. Takes no body — Webflow's optional custom-domain selector is itself an array this connector cannot express (C-185), so this always publishes to every connected domain rather than a caller-chosen subset

params.description: The site's id, as returned by webflow-site-list
params.name: site_id
